headline: The CIA secretly lifted a sunken Soviet nuclear submarine off the ocean floor.
slides: Soviet submarine K-129 sank in the Pacific with 98 crew and three nuclear missiles aboard.
The Soviets never found it. The US Navy did.
Billionaire Howard Hughes fronted a ship, the Hughes Glomar Explorer, built supposedly to mine the seabed.
After six years and hundreds of millions of dollars, it raised part of the sub from more than 3 miles down.
Six Soviet sailors found inside were buried at sea. The video was given to Russia in 1992.
When reporters asked, the CIA said it could 'neither confirm nor deny.' That answer started here.
